crossRefs.note: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.
The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

translations.web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
translations.bsb: A shrewd man keeps his knowledge to himself, but a foolish heart proclaims its folly.
translations.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
translations.asv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge; But the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
